title: Connect as an MCP server
intro: AI assistants such as Claude can read documents and prepare and issue invoices in this space over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), authenticated by a personal API token.
placeholder: Replace {placeholder} with a personal API token of this space.
tokensLink: Create a token on the API tokens page.
roles: Reading needs a token with at least the accountant role; creating and issuing invoices needs the member role.

claudeAi.title: claude.ai
claudeAi.open: Open Settings → Connectors and choose Add custom connector.
claudeAi.header: Under Request headers add {header} with the value {value}.
claudeAi.beta: The Request headers section is in beta for a limited set of organizations, so it may not be visible to you yet.

generic.title: Other MCP clients
generic.text: Any MCP client that supports the Streamable HTTP transport with custom headers works: use the server URL, transport and header above.

security: The token acts with its role in this space. Keep it secret; if it leaks, revoke it on the API tokens page.
